_doc: Grid plan for the look's four clothes icons (docs/look.md): one picture instead of four (the game-assets skill: always a grid). Cell order row by row, left to right. Generated on 2026-11-21 (job_id, output_url below); `python3 tools/garden/icons.py --plan localization/icon_grids_look.json` downloads it to design/look/, writes the sidecar and cuts textures/localized/ru/icon_<id>.jpg; then look at every cell, unreal/scripts/import_hall_assets.py and tools/ui_diary_icons.py <id> for the diary sketches.

grids.what: the department store's four pieces of clothing
grids.prompt: Four inventory icons for a moody adventure game, arranged as a 2 by 2 grid of equal square cells on one picture: in every cell one object centred and filling most of the cell, softly lit from the upper left, painterly realistic style, plain dark warm-grey cloth background with a faint vignette, the same background and the same scale in every cell (every object drawn at the same icon size, as large as the cell allows with a margin), no borders, frames or lines between the cells, nothing crossing a cell edge, exactly one object per cell, no text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere, not even on the objects. Clothes from a department store of a 1970s-80s Soviet seaside town, no real brands, no people. Row 1, left: a neatly folded bottle-green zip windbreaker of thin crisp fabric with a stand-up collar and elastic cuffs. Row 1, right: a neatly folded yellow rubberised raincoat with a hood and big press studs, a matte sheen on the folds. Row 2, left: a neatly folded heavy navy blue woollen winter coat with a dark fur collar and large buttons. Row 2, right: a grey herringbone tweed flat cap with a short stiff peak, seen from the front at three quarters.
